protocol.final_policy: Freeze one winner and all bytes before any of three fresh final references are read. Compare only winner vs release1.1 across all six cells. Failure retains v1.1; no runner-up or final tuning.
protocol.selection: Gate each candidate against v1.1 on all four validation match/regime cells; rank eligible by equal-cell mean spellF1, then macroF1, then name; baseline fallback.
protocol.tags: External automatic tags unavailable. Existing production tag fusion retained, not validated by this benchmark.
protocol.weighting_definition: Training-only inverse-sqrt H/A spell duration in seconds; final weights capped [0.5,3], live mean1, D/X0; no bridging D/X/half boundaries
